title: KS-889: Re-mint Platform S's API keys (Stuart's window) or accept without a backfill?
bluf: Measured on the demo box 2026-09-06: no existing key row says which connector it belongs to. A backfill would recover 5 of 32 active keys (16%), leave 26 with no evidence and 1 ambiguous. So the KS-843 flip (SUBJECTS_ERASE_SCOPE_ENFORCED, after the log shows Platform S on the new key) cannot get its evidence from existing keys; re-mint is the only sound path. A re-mint changes production credentials and needs Stuart's window (client-facing, communication from you). The comment says it is not a request to anyone, no message has gone to Platform S.

sources.quote: a backfill is NOT possible; re-mint is the only path
The re-mint is Stuart's window and Kam's call
no message has gone to Platform S from here

options.label: Re-mint Platform S keys in a window agreed with Stuart (prod credentials + message)
options.detail: Gives clean KS-843 evidence. Stuart must plan the switchover; merges with the KS-577 rotation conversation. You message Stuart.

options.label: Accept: no re-mint; decide the KS-843 flip on other evidence or keep logged grace
options.detail: No credential change and no message to Stuart. Existing keys keep logging connectorId null.

options.label: Defer the choice until you and Stuart next discuss the KS-577 rotation window
options.detail: No action now; the KS-843 flip keeps waiting.

default_action: After 48 h option c applies: no re-mint, no message to Stuart, the KS-843 flip keeps waiting. Safest and reversible.
